lines.start: Starey Owl puffs up its starry feathers and swivels its head round and round!
lines.puffing: Its wide golden eyes gleam brighter through the ferns!
lines.fizzle: Hoo-hoo! Every starry puff settles softly like moonlit snow.

lines.intro: A huge starry-eyed owl swoops onto the moss and stares straight at Fae! "WHOO-WHOO?!"
lines.command: How can Fae calm Starey Owl?

soothe.great: Fae hums a quiet lullaby of crickets and moonlight. Starey Owl's feathers droop gently!
soothe.good: Fae hums a soft woodland tune. Starey Owl blinks slowly.
soothe.miss: Starey Owl hoots a loud starry echo right over Fae's humming.

play.great: Maddie plays peekaboo behind a mossy fern. Starey Owl hoots a delighted giggle!
play.good: Maddie wiggles a moonlit leaf. Starey Owl tilts its head to watch.
play.miss: Maddie pounces at a firefly shadow and lands in a pile of moss.

cast.great: Sue's ribbon twirls like a shooting star! Starey Owl follows every shimmering loop!
cast.good: Sue swishes her bright ribbon through the clearing. Starey Owl watches closely.
cast.miss: Sue's ribbon snags on a pine twig. Starey Owl puffs its cheeks.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles glowing pinecones in a starry orbit. Starey Owl claps both wings!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses pinecones high in a steady arc. Starey Owl tracks each one.
juggle.miss: Jordan's pinecone bonks off a mossy root. Starey Owl gives a tiny grumpy hoot.

lines.snack: Fae tosses a crisp cracker crumb. Starey Owl snaps it up with a satisfied clack.
lines.burst: Starey Owl plays peekaboo! Tiptoe close while it looks away, and freeze when it stares!

burstResult.great: Fae tiptoes right up and freezes like a statue under the starry gaze!
burstResult.good: Fae tiptoes most of the way, only rustling a single fern leaf!
burstResult.miss: WHOO! Starey Owl spots Fae moving and startles her with a starry hoot!

lines.soothed: Starey Owl blinks its golden eyes soft and sleepy. The purple fizz drifts away like stardust!
lines.rest: Fae yawns under the starry gaze. Time for a cozy rest.
lines.run: Fae backs softly down the mossy path while Starey Owl watches from its perch.
